Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly instructed verification from multiple authoritative sources (including IMDb and Unifrance) to resolve the conflicting hint about “In My Skin,” WebSurfer repeated the same Wikipedia-only search without opening sources or extracting the “country” field. This failure to follow directions, cross-reference, or click through to confirm details allowed a misleading snippet (“Country of origin: United Kingdom”) to persist unchallenged, stalling resolution and risking an incorrect conclusion.
